messages:
maria: Handoff — I'm handing primary over to alex for the next 12h. Quick run-down of what happened during my shift so you don't need to dig through alerts:

maria: 1) Incident IN-2384 — increased p99 latency on hosted text-generation in us-west-2. Pager fired at ~01:12 UTC. Cause: autoscaler target CPU was accidentally set to 20% after a deploy, causing sustained under-provisioning during traffic spike. Mitigation: rolled back autoscaler change and scaled inference-runtime to 12 replicas, warmed prefix cache. Latency returned to baseline in ~18m. Impact: elevated latency for ~3 paying customers (slo breaches possible).

maria: 2) Incident IN-2385 — transient 503s on Dedicated pool when a node OOM'd during a large batch job. We cordoned the node, evicted the pod, and rebalanced. No customer data lost. Root cause follow-up: batch job memory limit was too low + unexpected spike from internal ETL job.

maria: Actions already taken:
- Rolled back autoscaler: `kubectl apply -f infra/autoscaler/us-west-2.yaml@rev-210`
- Scaled deployment: ```kubectl scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas=12 -n redwood-prod```
- Cordoned failing node: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-3-17` and recreated pod on healthy node.
- Opened tickets: INC-2384 (latency), INC-2385 (503/oom). Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2384 and https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2385

maria: Notes / runbook pointers:
- Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/oncall/runbooks/inference-latency
- If p99 > 700ms and >5% error rate, follow the infra autoscaler rollback section.
- For node OOMs see: https://wiki.redwood.com/oncall/runbooks/node-oom (check /var/log/kern.log and pod events)

alex: Taking primary now. Thanks for the handoff and the clear notes. I'll monitor for the next 12h and reopen INC-2384 if anything regresses. ETA to check dashboards in 10m.

sam: Heads-up — I'll file a follow-up ticket to add an early-warning alert for autoscaler underscaling. Suggestion: add a custom metric for target CPU vs actual and alert if target < 30% while request rate increased 2x. I'll create TKT-523 and link it to INC-2384.

kai: Small coverage gap FYI: I'm offline from 09:00-11:00 PST tomorrow. Alex, can you ping the oncall pager if you need a second set of eyes during that window? Our normal backup (lee) is on vacation.

alex: Noted. I can escalate to sam if needed. Also scheduling a short canary run to validate autoscaler behavior under synthetic load at 03:30 UTC.

maria: Post-handoff follow-ups I already kicked off:
- Retrospective scheduled: Friday 16:00 PT — calendar invite sent to eng-oncall, eng-runtime, and product ops. Notes doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1example-retro
- Action items assigned in the retro doc: add autoscaler test, add early-alert metric, tighten batch job memory limits, and add clear escalation path in runbook.

maria: Please add any small items here and I'll update the tickets before I log off in 20m. Thanks all and :thumbsup:

sam: Filed TKT-523: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-523 — linked to INC-2384. Will PR alert rule this afternoon.

incident-bot: Automated summary — INC-2384 closed by maria at 01:31 UTC. INC-2385 resolved by maria at 02:05 UTC. Total pages during shift: 3. Follow-up tickets created: INC-2384, INC-2385, TKT-523.

alex: Acknowledged. I'll watch dashboards and post any anomalies in this thread. If nothing else, I'll send a short status update at handoff end. :eyes:

kai: Thanks for the clear handoff, maria. I'll join the retro if my schedule allows.
